description:
The LIDCOM Training Scheme is an initiative launched by the Government of India to enhance the skills of individuals in the leather industry. 

This scheme was launched in 2018 as part of the broader Skill India Mission. 

The Skill India Mission aims to provide skill training to over 400 million people by 2022. 

The LIDCOM Training Scheme specifically targets the leather sector which is a significant contributor to India's economy. 

The leather industry in India is estimated to be worth approximately USD 12 billion. 

It employs around 4 million people directly and 13 million people indirectly. 

The primary objective of the LIDCOM Training Scheme is to provide skill development training to individuals in various aspects of leather production. 

This includes training in leather goods manufacturing, footwear production, and leather processing. 

The scheme aims to improve the employability of participants by providing them with industry-relevant skills. 

The target is to train around 1 lakh individuals under this scheme by the year 2022. 

The benefits of the LIDCOM Training Scheme include free training for participants. 

Participants also receive a stipend of INR 3,000 per month during the training period. 

The training duration varies from 3 months to 6 months depending on the specific skill being taught. 

The scheme also provides for the establishment of training centers across various states in India. 

These training centers are set up in collaboration with industry partners and organizations. 

Eligibility criteria for the LIDCOM Training Scheme include individuals aged between 18 to 35 years. 

Applicants must have completed at least the 8th standard of education. 

There is no upper age limit for candidates belonging to Scheduled Castes and Scheduled Tribes. 

The income criteria stipulate that candidates should belong to families with an annual income of less than INR 3 lakh. 

The application process for the LIDCOM Training Scheme involves several steps. 

Interested candidates must visit the official website of the Ministry of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises. 

They need to fill out the online application form available on the website. 

Required documents include proof of age, educational certificates, and income proof. 

Candidates must also submit a passport-sized photograph and an Aadhaar card. 

Once the application is submitted, candidates will receive a confirmation email. 

Selected candidates will be informed about the training schedule and location via email or SMS. 

The training is conducted in various states including Tamil Nadu, Uttar Pradesh, and West Bengal. 

The training centers are equipped with modern facilities and skilled trainers. 

The scheme also emphasizes practical training to ensure hands-on experience. 

Upon successful completion of the training, participants receive a certificate. 

This certificate is recognized by the Ministry of Skill Development and Entrepreneurship. 

The scheme also aims to promote entrepreneurship among trained individuals. 

Participants are encouraged to start their own businesses in the leather sector. 

Financial assistance is available for those who wish to set up their own enterprises. 

The scheme is implemented by the Ministry of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises. 

The Leather Industry Development Corporation is also involved in the implementation of the scheme. 

Contact details for inquiries can be found on the official website of the Ministry of MSME. 

The LIDCOM Training Scheme is part of the larger National Policy on Skill Development and Entrepreneurship. 

This policy was launched in 2015 to create a robust ecosystem for skill development in India. 

The government aims to enhance the quality of skill training and align it with industry needs. 

The scheme also focuses on promoting gender equality by encouraging women to participate. 

Women make up a significant portion of the workforce in the leather industry. 

The government has set a target of training at least 30% women under this scheme. 

The LIDCOM Training Scheme also aims to reduce the skill gap in the leather sector. 

This is crucial as the industry faces challenges in finding skilled labor. 

The scheme is expected to contribute to the overall growth of the leather industry in India. 

It is aligned with the Make in India initiative which aims to boost manufacturing in the country. 

The leather sector is identified as a priority sector under this initiative. 

The government has also introduced various incentives for the leather industry. 

These include subsidies for technology upgrades and financial assistance for exports. 

The LIDCOM Training Scheme is a step towards making the leather industry more competitive globally. 

It aims to enhance the quality of products produced in India. 

The scheme also addresses the need for sustainable practices in leather production. 

Training includes modules on eco-friendly production techniques. 

This is in line with global trends towards sustainability in manufacturing. 

The LIDCOM Training Scheme is a significant effort by the Indian government to empower individuals. 

It aims to create a skilled workforce that can contribute to the economy. 

The scheme is expected to have a positive impact on employment rates in the leather sector. 

It also aims to uplift the socio-economic status of families involved in leather production. 

The government continues to monitor the progress of the scheme. 

Regular assessments are conducted to evaluate the effectiveness of training programs. 

Feedback from participants is also taken into account for improvements. 

The LIDCOM Training Scheme represents a comprehensive approach to skill development in the leather industry. 

It combines training with financial support and entrepreneurship development. 

This holistic approach is essential for the sustainable growth of the sector. 

The scheme is a testament to the government's commitment to skill development in India. 

It reflects the need for targeted interventions in specific industries. 

The LIDCOM Training Scheme is a crucial initiative for the future of the leather industry in India. 

It aims to create a skilled workforce that can meet the demands of the global market. 

The scheme is expected to play a vital role in the economic development of the country.
